title: Contact rate limit keyed on a client-controlled X-Forwarded-For hop
evidence: infra/nginx/lander-records.conf.example:29 proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for (appends; first hop is caller-supplied)
rootCause: The first XFF entry is supplied by the caller when the proxy appends; the trusted address is X-Real-IP / the last hop.
invariantViolated: Abuse controls must key on a proxy-verified identity
blastRadius: unbounded submissions by rotating a header; polluted ip_hash data

autofix.reason: pure function with unit tests; no data migration

correction: lib/contact-client-ip.ts: X-Real-IP, else last XFF hop
regressionRisk: medium — deployments without X-Real-IP rely on the nearest proxy being the last hop (documented in leads/rate-limit.md)

history.note: header trust review against the reference proxy config
root cause traceable in repo; autofix eligible
re-running the detecting check on the fixed code
